name: Manipulator

60231.name: Repair Device I
60231.SpecificEffects: When the action starts, repair yourself <color=#F74848>once</color>, restoring HP equal to <color=#F74848>0.6x</color> the Manipulator's Repair AMT. This cannot repair damaged parts.

RelatedDescription: An engineering backpack fitted with a high-precision robotic arm that provides professional repairs on the battlefield.
